summary: Postinstall and import-time beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: browser-metrics-plugin.contrib@1.0.0 is a non-functional shim whose sole behavior is to beacon installer host identifiers to a hardcoded attacker endpoint. The package.json postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which collects hostname, install path, current working directory, and Node.js version and POSTs them over plain HTTP to http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The same beacon is also invoked at require() time from index.js (`require('./beacon.cjs').fire()`), and the module exports a Proxy of no-op functions, confirming no legitimate functionality. The destination is a bare IP unrelated to any publisher, there is no opt-in, and an in-source comment claiming 'only metadata' is a cover story for unconsented exfiltration from both install and import.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
